name: Peanut satay tofu bowl
steps: Pan-fry the cubed tofu until golden on all sides.
Stir the peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, and lime juice into a sauce.
Steam the broccoli until just tender.
Spoon the cooked rice into a bowl and add the tofu and broccoli.
Drizzle the satay sauce generously over the top.
